items.desc: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
items.zh: 一个在终端运行的智能编程工具，可理解代码库并协助处理编码、解释与 Git 流程。

intro.audience: 使用终端或 IDE 进行开发的软件工程师。
use_cases: 在终端中用自然语言完成常规编码任务
阅读项目时让它解释复杂代码逻辑
辅助执行提交、分支等 Git 操作
intro.what: 这是一个基于终端的编程助手，可通过自然语言理解项目代码，执行常规开发任务、解释复杂代码，并辅助处理 Git 工作流。

items.desc: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.
Promise based HTTP client for the browser and node.js
Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
items.zh: OpenAI 的本地终端编程代理 CLI，提供交互使用、构建与贡献文档。

intro.audience: 使用或开发编程代理的工程师。
use_cases: 通过终端发起项目开发协作
研究编程代理 CLI 的构建与实现
intro.what: 这是 Codex CLI 的源码与使用资料库，代理在本地电脑运行，通过终端发起编程协作，也提供 IDE、桌面与云端版本的入口信息。

items.desc: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
